data.rationale: jcv_floor relies on jcv_real_to_int returning the truncated integer value to prove floor semantics: result <= v and v - result < 1.0. Without this postcondition from jcv_real_to_int, jcv_floor cannot prove its own postconditions ensures \result <= v and ensures v - \result < 1.0.

data.message: Added two truncation postconditions to the published spec v2: `ensures \is_finite(v) && v >= 0.0 ==> (\result <= v && v - \result < 1.0)` and `ensures \is_finite(v) && v < 0.0 ==> (\result >= v && \result - v < 1.0)`. Both are verified. The sign split is necessary because C truncation-toward-zero means for negative v the result is >= v, not <= v.
